data.title: The Design Decision Founders Regret After 6 Months
data.html_title: The Design Decision Founders Regret After 6 Months
data.html_description: A design decision that feels right early on often becomes a source of friction six months later. Why founders regret it — and how it quietly shapes growth.
data.description: We lost three weeks building a component library nobody asked for. Thirty-seven reusable components, documented spacing tokens, a complete color system.
